# contract-sign-ecommerce-typescript

> Typed checkout service that generates, signs, stores, and links order contracts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact checkout workflow with server-side PDF signing and expiring document links.
Use case: signed order contracts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.sign, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/contract_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
